ancestral-lineage:
In a realm where power is determined by affinities—elemental forces that shape magic, combat, and survival—Ethan is an anomaly. While most people are born with a single affinity, Ethan stands apart, wielding a vast range of abilities granted by a mysterious Ancestral-line System. This unique system taps into the untapped potential of his vampire and dwarven bloodline, unlocking ancestral powers far beyond the norm.
At just 18 years old, Ethan's journey begins when he accidentally awakens this system, discovering that he is the heir to a forgotten lineage that blends the strength, resilience, and mysticism of both vampire and dwarven ancestors, a perfect hybrid of both. Though he must awaken and evolve to harness their power. However, the more power he gains, the more he learns about the dark secrets of his lineage—secrets that others would kill to possess.
Unlike everyone else, Ethan's affinities are not innate; they are granted by the system based on his bloodline’s ancient heritage.…
apocalypse-rebirth-crazy-from-day-one:
In her previous life, Stella Sterling struggled bitterly in the apocalypse for seven years.
When she opened her eyes again, she was back one month before the apocalypse, being cornered and beaten up by people hired by her adopted sister.
Given a second chance, how could she still let others beat and curse her?
You want my life? Heh heh, you'll have to pay with your own life first!
Rolling up her sleeves, she charged forward, grabbing a club and smashing it at them.
Of course, the most important thing was still to hoard supplies. No money, what to do?
Win the lottery, sell jewelry, sell, sell, sell everything useless, and then buy, buy, buy. If that's still not enough, it's time for some “zero-dollar shopping.”
In this life, she wouldn't have an empty dimensional space with no supplies; she wanted to be the wealthiest person in the apocalypse, and the most ferocious blade!
What, those thugs still want to sue her?
It's the apocalypse, so I'm going to be lawless, so what!!!
Everyone said the young lady of the Sterling Family had gone mad overnight, selling off gifts from her elders to frantically amass wealth, disrespecting her elders, and becoming despised by all.…

But something felt off—I couldn’t recall seeing her in any anime, manga, or games I had ever come across. Confused, I asked my friend standing next to me.
To my shock, his response sent chills down my spine:
“Huh? What catgirl? What are you talking about?”
Suddenly, a truck came barreling toward the girl. Without thinking, I rushed to save her. In the end, both of us were hit by the truck.
Now, I find myself reincarnated in another world—in the body of the very catgirl I had seen.

How is she related to the dungeons that keep popping up in this new world?

clan-cultivation-i-transmigrated-with-my:
Lu Xuanji transmigrated to the Zifu Realm and realized that cultivation was an arduous journey.
Due to the monopoly of resources, the strong grew stronger while the weak turned weaker. His clan was in a difficult situation. As he munched on cold, leftover food, he thought of the pathetic situation that his clan was in.
Thankfully, his cellphone transmigrated along with him.
The File Manager app, which could store a large amount of information, was used to store 10,000 scrolls of martial arts techniques.
The Fortune Reading app, which could analyze information input, was used to deduce future events and break down martial arts techniques.
Google Maps, which showed panoramic views of different terrains, was used to locate enemies and identify spots for minerals.
The Phone Banking service allowed him to exchange currency for spiritual stones.
The mobile game, Orchard, allowed him to get spiritual fruits by planting trees.
As such, Lu Xuanji led his clan to rise up to the pinnacle of life.

maybe-i-really-am-a-villian:
“Why are you trying to kill me, Princess…?”
The silver-haired boy’s voice was faint, barely audible over the sound of his own ragged breathing. He lay sprawled across the cold marble floor, his body drenched in blood that slowly pooled beneath him.
The blonde-haired girl looked down at him, her blue eyes devoid of warmth.
“It’s not my fault, Asher,” she replied in an indifferent tone. “This is the result of your own stubbornness. I simply asked you to join my faction… but you insisted on remaining neutral. I can’t allow a wild card like you to roam free.”
Asher let out a weak, breathless chuckle, the sound tinged with mockery.
“I don’t think… that’s the whole truth, Princess.”
For a brief moment, her gaze sharpened.
“…You’re right. There is another reason.”
“And what is that?” he asked, his voice trembling but his eyes steady.
Her lips curled ever so slightly.
“You’re a pathetic fool. Someone with enough talent to grasp power… yet no desire for revenge.”
“Revenge?” Asher murmured, as if tasting the word. “For what? My mother’s death? And against whom?”
“Against the demons who caused it.”
A low, broken laugh escaped his lips.
“Haha… Princess, don’t joke.…
